title: Nagi no Oitoma
synopsis: The story centers on Nagi Ooshima, a girl who is too conscious of everyone's mood and can't really get close to anyone. One day, she collapses from hyperventilation. After talking to her ex-boyfriend, she quits work, moves, and runs away from everything to start anew. (Source: Anime News Network) Notes: - Won the 65th Shogakukan Manga Award for Best Shoujo Manga in 2019. - Nominated to the 23rd Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

titleNative: 何の取り柄もない平凡な俺が美人双子姉妹を命懸けで助けた結果、実はヤンデレだった二人をガチ惚れさせてしまった件
synonyms: I, an Ordinary Guy with No Redeeming Qualities, Risked My Life to Save Beautiful Twin Sisters, Only to Make the Secretly Yandere Duo Fall Madly in Love with Me
synopsis: Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─. Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!? Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!? Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!

synopsis: Leo, a mage, is expelled from the heroic party by Kane, the brave, because he just can't get on with. However, after Leo leaves, the party continues to lose. Kane asks Leo to return to the party, but Leo fed up with Kane's unmannerly attitude, asks Kane to get down on his knees... Kane's pride is shattered, and when Kane shows tears for the first time, Leo feels a certain excitement...? (Source: Libre, translated) Notes: - Chapter 13 was split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release. “Stretch (ストレッチ)” published in Pixiv Comic was not included in any of the volumes. - Includes six extra chapters.
